title: Hasta luego
subtitle: Saying goodbye
scene: It’s late. Time to go, which in Mexico takes a while.

culture.title: Despedidas
culture.text: Say goodbye to every person, one by one, just like the greeting. A goodbye that takes twenty minutes is completely normal.

si.n: ¡Pero si…! adds surprise: But it’s early!

lines.note: Hosts always protest. It means they enjoyed your company.

lines.es: Muchas gracias por todo. La cena estuvo deliciosa.
lines.en: Thank you so much for everything. Dinner was delicious.
lines.note: Estuvo = was (past of estar). Learn it as a set phrase for now.

lines.es: Vuelve pronto, ¿eh? Aquí tienes tu casa.
lines.en: Come back soon, okay? You always have a home here.
Of course. Take good care, ma’am!
lines.note: Cuídese (usted) / cuídate (tú) = take care. A warm Mexican goodbye.
Many younger Mexicans say “bye” in English.
Que descansen = rest well (to everyone). A kind way to say good night as you leave.
